items.title: Understanding Strong Passwords and Their Role in Data Protection

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Understanding Strong Passwords and Their Role in Data Protection under 9.1 as printed (PDF 123, printed 119).

blocks.text: A strong password is a combination of letters, numbers, and symbols that helps protect your accounts from hackers. Using unique passwords for different accounts reduces the chance of being hacked. It's best to avoid personal details like names or birthdays. Passwords should be changed regularly and not shared with others. A secure password acts as the first line of defense in protecting important files and data online.
